title: Explore a reusable bag option
summary: Plan a small, reversible personal habit that could reduce disposable bags.
objective: An informed private plan that respects access, food safety, and local regulations.
steps: Review available bag reuse and cleaning guidance from a reliable source.
Identify an accessible low-cost option you could personally test.
Reflect on whether this option might cause inconvenience, waste, or accessibility barriers.
reflection_prompt: Which conditions would make this change unreasonable or ineffective?
accessibility_alternative: Research online or ask a trusted friend to help compare options; no purchase required.
consent_requirement: Only investigate your own habits; do not request information about others.
safety_notes: Avoid claims about health and material life cycles without evidence; do not contact or pressure strangers.

review.community_need: Some households are curious whether reusable alternatives are practical and affordable in their circumstances.
review.affected_people: Only the participant is directly involved; family or others are not asked to participate.
review.potential_harms: Costs, cleaning demands and disability-related access barriers could make reuse less practical.
review.mitigation_plan: Keep the activity voluntary, free to complete, and limited to research with no obligation to buy.
review.permissions_plan: No third-party access or special authorization is necessary for a private research-only draft.
review.accessibility_plan: Provide remote, audio or assistance-based alternatives and avoid requiring a purchase or travel.
review.impact_measure: Measure whether a participant identifies a feasible option; make no claims that waste was reduced.
review.stop_conditions: Stop if the idea requires unsafe cleaning, spending money, or pressure on other people.
review.data_handling: Do not collect names, contact details, photographs or private household records.
review.accountability_route: Invite correction through a safe maintainer review; do not publish claims about anyone.
